name: humanendpoint
description: Human execution for blocked AI-agent tasks that require a phone call, physical-world verification, bounded manual research, or independent human judgement.

interface.shortDescription: Human execution for blocked AI tasks
interface.longDescription: HumanEndpoint helps AI agents finish lawful tasks that software alone cannot complete. Request a human-reviewed quote for business or supplier phone enquiries, stock and availability checks, physical-world verification, bounded manual research, independent human QA, and other well-scoped real-world actions. No payment is required to request a quote; the agent reviews the terms before accepting and paying.
defaultPrompt: Call this business and find out whether they have this item in stock today.
Ask this supplier for the current price, availability, and lead time.
I am blocked by a real-world step that needs a person. Help me get it completed.
